newsitem.title: GERMANY: Buba's Koebnick-delay of EMU launch may be useful.
newsitem.headline: Buba's Koebnick-delay of EMU launch may be useful.

text.p: Bundesbank council member Hans-Juergen Koebnick on Wednesday reiterated his view that Europe may wish to consider delaying the launch of its currency union in order to have more time to prepare for it.

"A conditioned waiting for the currency union would not be a catastrophe," Koebnick told Reuters in an interview, adding it would be worth considering whether the goals "would not be more in reach if one waited another year or two."

Koebnick has on several occasions suggested it would be preferable to postpone the scheduled January 1, 1999 launch date rather than have the currency union collapse because of inadequate preparation.

This view contrasts with Chancellor Helmut Kohl's statements that neither the entry date nor the entry criteria can be altered as both are enshrined in the Maastricht Treaty and any change could be considered a breach of the contract.
